item.title: My Nine Month Road Trip Around the USA
item.description:
The idea is to travel to a city, to live there for a few weeks, and then to move on to another city.

— Heading out of Portland, August 2014

From September 2014 to May 2015 I lived in seven cities, working remotely during the day and exploring in the evenings and on weekends.
